name: OMV Aktiengesellschaft
research_rationale: Q3 results and higher TTM free cash flow support the strong-buy screen, but oil-linked volatility, Libya outages, broker downgrades and weaker forward earnings views still cap conviction.

weekly_updates.summary:
Refreshed financials show Q3 2026 EPS €3.14, revenue €8.96bn and quarterly free cash flow €1.43bn; TTM free cash flow in sources is ~€2.53bn.
News is mixed: stronger operating-profit headlines and a Kepler €71 target versus UBS/Oddo downgrades, Libya pipeline disruption, oil-linked share moves and “below prior quarter” commentary.
Indexed filings are unchanged since September; no new filing bodies in this batch.
